comparison.objective: Brake a coasting flywheel safely, then remove and tray its hub nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a brake control until zero speed, avoid stored-energy hazards, then perform threaded removal.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel stopped without hand contact; nut removed and placed upright; brake released and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Residual-energy control and subsequent nut removal do not exercise rail-jig alignment or continuous bearing support.
